currentParagraphText: “Alright, alright,” Irin shrugged as she went into the fifth clothing store in a row, with Jake not even bothering to enter this one. He still didn’t understand why Irin kept buying clothes that didn’t even provide any stats, and none of her explanations made sense either, so he’d just chosen to accept it. He could understand that she wanted a few sets, but at this point, she had to at least have bought a dozen.
